title: Mitopure™ (Proprietary Urolithin A) Bioavailability in Healthy Adults

sections.abstract: This is a single-center, two-period, crossover, randomized, open labelled study enrolling 100 healthy subjects to evaluate the Urolithin A producer status and to compare bioavailabilty of direct dietary supplementation with Mitopure™ (proprietary Urolithin A) to dietary exposure with pomegranate juice
